summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K to disclose that it submitted its 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F with the U.S. SEC. The filing also includes a copy of the disclosure letter sent to the Philippine Stock Exchange and Philippine SEC. This is a routine annual regulatory compliance filing, not a special situation event. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or capital action is announced. The filing is purely informational with no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors named. What to watch: no event to monitor as this is standard reporting.
